premarket.market_expectations: Neutral bias prevails as overnight US tech weakness offsets domestic institutional support. The Nifty's middle-third close suggests balanced positioning, while falling crude and rupee strength provide tailwinds. However, spiking US yields and Nasdaq futures' steep decline may cap upside. Earnings reports and oil price movements will likely drive stock-specific action amid normal conviction levels.
